├─ 😈 /usr/bin/tool
│     • net/socket/connect — connects to a remote host - via TCP:
│     AF_INET
│     • c2/addr/url — contains a hardcoded URL. Often benign:
│     https://example.com/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa…
│     • exec/shell — runs shell commands: /bin/sh, sh -c, $sh_var
│     • fs/file/read — reads files
│     • anti-static/obfuscation/hex — hex-encoded payload:
│     \\x41\\x42, evil\x1b[2Jpayload\ttab, naïve 😈 rtl
│     • sus/text — : password, credential
│     • nonamespace — no slash in the ID: abcd, abcde
│     • hw/cpu — reads cpu info: cpuinfo
│     • os/env/get — calls getenv: setenv
│     • net/dns — resolves names: gethostbyname
│     • collect/files — collects files: glob
│     • malware/family — names a family
│     • fs/file/write — writes files - often: fwrite, fopen
├─ 🔵 /tmp/naïve 😈\x1b]0;title\a\\backslash
│     • fs/write — writes files: fopen
